verses.1: Tov-Rash walks with his lips parted, and he is ignorant.
verses.2: Even without knowledge of the soul, one cannot live well; their feet are also in a state of decay.
verses.3: May man’s ways be corrected, and may his heart be filled with hatred toward Jehovah.
verses.4: He will have many enemies, but he will be defeated by his enemies.
verses.5: False witnesses will not be accepted; they will be treated as liars. They will not be believed at all.
verses.6: Many will turn away from the generous person, and all his enemies will give him up to someone else.
verses.7: All those who hated Rosh, even though they were his enemies, still kept away from him. They said to him, “Where is he?”
verses.8: A person with a kind heart loves those who keep their promises and strive to find what’s good.
verses.9: False witnesses will not be forgiven; they will be destroyed, just like lies.
verses.10: Do not be pleased with fools; they will not be satisfied, even if they serve those who are wise.
verses.11: A person’s intelligence and pride are more important than their sins.
verses.12: Naham Kafir Zaeph Maelk, and he laid waste to the land they desired.
verses.13: He became a son of his father, but he was foolish and worthless. He was driven away from the house of his mother.
verses.14: The house and the land belong to the ancestors. And from Jehovah, a woman who is wise was born.
verses.15: Despair, falling, darkness, and a soul filled with hunger.
verses.16: He keeps the commandment; he protects his soul. He follows his ways, and he lives.
verses.17: May the Lord’s blessing be upon him; may He reward him accordingly.
verses.18: You shall not kill your son, for there is a commandment against it. And you shall not take his life.
verses.19: Great-Hema will carry punishment, if he does not save them.
verses.20: Listen to the advice and accept the task, so that you may be wise in the future.
verses.21: Many thoughts in a person’s heart, but it is the wisdom of Jehovah that brings them to life.
verses.22: May God grant kindness and goodness to those who are honest and good people.
verses.23: The fear of Jehovah is life-giving; it makes people strong and not subject to harm.
verses.24: He tied his hand to the pole; even his mouth couldn’t be moved.
verses.25: May he be struck and destroyed; may his forest be desolated. May it serve as a warning to those who seek to understand the truth.
verses.26: The father will drive away the son who is proud and arrogant.
verses.27: Hades, son of God, listen to the messages from those who possess knowledge.
verses.28: Let the wicked be punished by judgment, and let their mouths be filled with poison.
verses.29: We must follow the rules and procedures set forth for those who are foolish.
